A first-class foolish activity.
If I did not enjoy the taste, why was I continuing to drink?

Getting drunk did not clear my mind. Even a little pleasant sleepiness would not come. My chest stayed cold; sleep kept its distance.

Completely useless liquor. What purpose it had, I could not say.

On that point, we were very similar.

en.html:
I knew she was watching from beside me. I did not meet her eyes. I gave my full attention to the work: pour the drink, carry the cup.

Originally, drinking had not been a great favorite of mine. But in the old days I could appreciate some of the taste. My adoptive mother enjoyed both drink and tobacco, and I had received instruction accordingly. With tobacco, my education had gone nowhere. With liquor, they said the more one drank, the better one understood its true flavor. There, at least, some result had come from the teaching.

Now I could not even remember that feeling.

It was horrible. To have no taste at all could be this unpleasant? That was a discovery.

Drink.

The taste of poison fished up memories of poison. With every mouthful, something flashed through my mind.

A face.
The face of someone dead.

Someone these hands had killed.

Mass murder. No uncertainty about the guilt.

Unforgivable.
It had to be judged.

...But judgment would not come for me.

Then what was I alive to do? Some act to answer the dead?

...I could do nothing.

What was this, then?

What was this person, Kageaki Minato?

Was it all right for such a man to exist?

Drink.

The liquor was like a corrosive. I could hear it eating through my insides.

Drink.

A slow, gnawing sting.

Drink.

Slowly, the sting soaked in.

Drink—

隣からの視線に気付いてはいたが、俺は目を合わせ
なかった。
　酒を注ぎ、杯を運ぶ作業に没頭する。

　元々、好きな方ではない。
　しかし昔は、多少の味わいなら理解できた。

　<ruby>養母<rt>はは</rt></ruby>が酒も煙草も好む人で、俺も仕込まれた所為だ。
　煙草の方はさっぱりだったが、酒は飲めば飲むほど
正味に通ずると言われる通り、幾らかは教育の成果も
上がった。

　あの頃の感覚を、今はもう思い出せない。

　酷く、不味い。
　味がしないという事はこんなにも不快なのかと驚く。

　飲む。

　毒の味は、毒の記憶を釣り出した。
　一口毎に、脳裏で閃くものがある。

　人の顔。
　死者の顔だ。

　この手に掛けて殺した人間。

　紛れもない大量殺戮の罪。

　決して許されぬ。
　裁かれねばならぬ。
　
　……しかし、俺は裁かれない。

　ならば生きて何をする。
　死者に報いる何事かを為すのか。
　
　……何もできない。

　一体、何なのだ。

　湊斗景明とは何なのだ。

　こんな人間がいて良いのか。

　飲む。

　酒は腐蝕剤のようだった。
　五臓六腑を蝕む音が聴こえる。

　飲む。

　じくじくと。

　飲む。

　じくじくと、<ruby>沁<rt>し</rt></ruby>みる。

　飲む――

That was my verdict on myself.

But then what? Was I claiming that until now I had been some magnificent decent fellow?

I had been contemptible. More than anyone. Only the outside had been kept presentable.

Enough. That useless maintenance could stop.

A contemptible man should behave contemptibly. At least there would be consistency.

Sink.

Sink completely.

Muramasa would forgive me.

Even this version of me—
